correctness.rationale: The common-refinement criterion gives exactly 25 complete ordered triple types. The incidence graph equivalence is exact. Three-stars on both shores and a three-edge matching require at least six graph edges; shared centers plus one edge away from the centers attain the bound in exactly four configurations. Commutation is equivalent to rectangular connected components by three-corner completion. In a commuting universal graph, both three-stars in one component force nine edges; otherwise the three-edge-path requirement forces at least six plus three edges. All equality cases are enumerated by the three component multisets. Full proof is in RESULT.md; verify_profiles.py independently confirms 25, 6/4, 9/3 on finite complete size ranges.

value.rationale: The minimal number of elements simultaneously realizing all bounded-arity local equality profiles is a natural finite-model resource invariant. Distinct three-edge configurations force nontrivial interactions between matching, branching and path requirements. The theorem gives a sharp and structural contrast for the algebraically significant commuting-equivalence restriction (six versus nine), a full four-plus-three extremizer classification and all-cardinality existence, rather than an arbitrary small computation.
